title: Membership in a concatenated list
statement: For any type $\alpha$, list of lists $ls$ over $\alpha$, and element $a \in \alpha$, the element $a$ belongs to the concatenation of $ls$ if and only if there is a list $l$ in $ls$ that contains $a$.
